title: Normalized scalar Tate line witness
statement: For finite coefficient rings A and A' and a ring map A → A', under the positive annihilator and base unit hypotheses there exist an annihilator hA' and a degree-one Tate-line comparison c satisfying the prescribed PurityScalarLineNormalization equation.

proof.text: Apply the coefficient homomorphism to the equation N = 0 in A to obtain N = 0 in A′. Map the given global unit through the germ ring homomorphism at each point of B; ring homomorphisms preserve natural-number casts and units, giving the stalkwise unit hypothesis.

Apply finite_tate_scalar_source_normalization_exists of [lem-pur-finite-tate-scalar-source-existence] to obtain a family beta with IsFiniteTateScalarBalancing of [def-pur-finite-tate-scalar-source-data]. Take c = beta 1; the degree-one finite Tate twist is definitionally the finite Tate line.

Specialize the balancing generator equation to degree one, new coefficient b = 1, and the constant singleton root tuple z. The power generator reduces to the line generator, scalar multiplication by 1 and multiplication by 1 disappear, and the unit followed by restriction of c.hom is the scalar-adjunction transpose. This is exactly PurityScalarLineNormalization of [def-pur-vector-purity-finite-reduction].

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2, coefficient reduction; direct degree-one specialization of the existing balancing existence theorem, formalized by T2

lean.statement: theorem exists_purityScalarLineNormalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤))) (A' : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A'] [Finite A'] (φ : A →+* A') : ∃ hA' : (N : A') = 0, ∃ c : (Etale.purityScalarSheaf φ B).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B N A hA) ≅ Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B N A' hA', PurityScalarLineNormalization φ N hA hA' B c
